scope: frozen 2014-2020 developmental top-decile RB; controlled +10% source-points perturbation
exact_mechanism: D1 conditional state means are fitted in raw future-point space, with source magnitude entering mostly through standardized log1p(source_points); the learned RB source elasticity is strongly sub-unit.

The shared ordered-state layer also includes dpts=clip((source_points-prior1_points)/100,-2,2). For RB, ordered-threshold dpts coefficients are negative, so a large current-season spike versus prior history shifts active-state mass downward even while source points rise.
Because conditional points rise little or can fall while the retention denominator rises one-for-one, conditional retention falls sharply with source magnitude.
Prior1/prior2 terms are comparatively small and do not explain the main slope.
